bivariate_pairs.rationale: Variance and skewness both describe distribution shape; their interaction may reveal distinct patterns for each class.
High variance combined with kurtosis could differentiate between normal and heavy-tailed distributions across classes.
Skewness and kurtosis together capture asymmetry and tail heaviness, potentially informative for class separation.
Entropy measures information content; its relationship with variance may highlight variability in information across classes.
Combining entropy with skewness could expose how disorder relates to asymmetry in the data.
Entropy vs kurtosis may uncover links between information density and tail behavior.
